what: The GWLB Leibniz-Archiv's checked transcriptions of the Leibniz correspondence (Transkriptionen des Leibniz-Briefwechsels <year> für die Leibniz-Akademie-Ausgabe, überprüft), the K2b test set's source. One PDF a year, the newest version the year's repository page names.
use: internal evaluation only (SPECS §1.4 and §7.3, TDM): never on the website, never in a release, never in a committed file, never in training, never for choosing a checkpoint. The PDFs and everything extracted from them stay under data/ (gitignored).
